references.text: The original instruction to make the covering of red dyed ram skins and badger skins over the tabernacle
The people brought red dyed ram skins and badger skins as materials for the tabernacle
The description that the covering of red dyed ram skins and badger skins was made for the tabernacle
The original instruction to make the curtain that would separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place
The description that the curtain was made with cherubim woven into it
Moses set up the covering over the tabernacle and hung the curtain that hid the ark of the testimony
The Gershonites were to carry the coverings of the tabernacle, including the covering of badger skins
Connects the material list in the instruction with the actual execution of the same part of the tabernacle.
Highlights how the original divine instruction regarding materials was precisely followed in the execution.
